description: An agent-based model simulating mask-wearing behavior spread through social networks, incorporating social influence and government interventions.

behaviors.name: adopt_mask_wearing
behaviors.description: Behavior where a person decides to wear a mask based on risk perception and social influence.
behaviors.algorithm: If risk_perception > risk_perception_threshold or influenced by connections, adopt mask-wearing.

behaviors.name: influence_others
behaviors.description: Influences other agents in the network to adopt mask-wearing behavior.
behaviors.algorithm: For each connection, with probability influence_probability, attempt to influence mask-wearing adoption.

interactions.name: influence_interaction
interactions.description: Interaction where one person influences another to adopt mask-wearing behavior.
interactions.effect: Increase likelihood of adopting mask-wearing for the influenced person.

algorithms.adopt_mask_wearing_algorithm: Risk perception and social influence based decision-making

data_sources.name: agent_attributes.csv
data_sources.purpose: Initialize agent attributes such as risk perception and initial mask-wearing status.

data_sources.name: social_network.json
data_sources.purpose: Define the structure and connections of the social network.

data_sources.name: train_data.csv
data_sources.purpose: Calibrate and validate the model using historical behavior data.

files.name: main_simulation.py
files.description: Entry point for running the mask-wearing behavior simulation.

files.name: agent.py
files.description: Defines the Person entity and its behaviors.

files.name: network.py
files.description: Manages the network structure and information propagation.

files.name: utils.py
files.description: Utility functions for data processing and analysis.
